title: One Body
description: A wobbly physics party game for 1–6 players: everyone controls one limb of the same floppy creature (play solo and you get both legs), and one limb is a secret traitor. Walk it past rubber ducks, a spinning bar, boulders, a backwards conveyor and an angry goose to the cake before time runs out. Watch the slow-motion replay after every fall, call meetings and vote limbs off. Play with friends by room code, join Quick Play, or play solo with bots.
